result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. 

**The bug:** Line 42 in `tally/invoice.py` used `>` (greater than) instead of `>=` (greater than or equal to) when checking if a bulk discount should apply.

**The fix:** Changed `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` to `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` 

The test `test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units` expects the bulk discount to apply when there are exactly 10 units, but the original condition only triggered for more than 10 units. This aligns with the code comment on line 9: "Orders of **at least** this many units get BULK_PERCENT off".
